proposals.before: Transported transferred Shan Dong grain, to supply central capital officials, year not over several ten thousand shi.
proposals.after: Transported transferred Shan Dong grain, to supply central capital officials, year not over several hundred thousand shi.
proposals.reason: 數十萬 means several hundred thousand, not several ten thousand; the idiomatic rendering is already correct.

proposals.before: East to vast sea commandery, people troops expenses comparable to south barbarians.
proposals.after: East to Canghai Commandery, people troops expenses comparable to south barbarians.
proposals.reason: 滄海之郡 is the commandery name Canghai, not a descriptive vast sea; matches the idiomatic field and s0029.

proposals.before: At that point, Grand Farmer Chen’s reserves of money were already spent, the taxes were exhausted, and they still were not enough to support the soldiers.
proposals.after: At that point, the Grand Farmer’s stored reserves of money were already spent, the taxes were exhausted, and they still were not enough to support the soldiers.
proposals.reason: 陳藏錢 means stored/laid-up money of the Grand Farmer office, not a personal name Chen; inventing Grand Farmer Chen misidentifies an office phrase as a person.

proposals.before: Ranks seventeen thousand, altogether worth thirty more ten thousand gold.
proposals.after: Ranks one hundred seventy thousand, altogether worth thirty more ten thousand gold.
proposals.reason: 十七萬 is 170,000, not 17,000; the idiomatic figure is already correct.

proposals.before: From the time Gongsun Hong used the moral principles of the Spring and Autumn Annals to bind his subordinates and became Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang used crafty legal argument to reach the position of imperial counselor, public affairs came to rely heavily on documentation and technical legal reasoning.
proposals.after: From the time Gongsun Hong used the righteousness of the Spring and Autumn Annals to bind his subordinates and became Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang used crafty legal rhetoric to decide cases and became Commandant of Justice, the law of seeing-and-knowing arose, and the prosecutions for obstruction, frustration, slander, and exhaustive investigation were put into use.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 廷尉 not imperial counselor, and continues with 見知之法 and 廢格沮誹窮治之獄, which the idiomatic English omits and replaces with an invented summary.

proposals.before: The laws became increasingly strict, and many clerks were abolished and exempted.
proposals.after: The laws became increasingly strict, and many clerks were dismissed from office.
proposals.reason: 廢免 means clerks were removed or cashiered from office, not that offices were abolished and persons exempted; the current phrasing confuses dismissal with the purchase of exemptions in the next sentence.

proposals.before: Zheng Dang Shi because Wei transport canal circuitous far, chiseled straight canal from Chang An to Hua Yin, workers several ten thousand;
proposals.after: Zheng Dangshi, because the Wei transport canal was circuitous and far, chiseled a straight canal from Chang'an to Huayin, workers several ten thousand;
proposals.reason: The personal name and place names are incorrectly spaced as separate syllables, obscuring that 鄭當時, 長安, and 華陰 are single proper nouns.

proposals.before: Xian Yang, Qi great boiled salt, Kong Jin, Nan Yang great smelter, all brought living accumulated thousand gold, therefore Zheng Dang Shi advanced spoke them.
proposals.after: Xianyang, Qi's great salt boiler, Kong Jin, Nanyang's great smelter, all had amassed living capital of a thousand gold; therefore Zheng Dangshi recommended them.
proposals.reason: Spaced name fragments and calqued 致生 obscure that these are personal and place names and that both men had accumulated fortunes.

proposals.before: Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. When the Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi’s name, he recognized him and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier.”
proposals.after: Henan submitted a register of wealthy men who had aided the poor. When the Son of Heaven saw Bu Shi’s name, he recognized him and said, “This is the man who earlier wished to contribute half his property to aid the frontier,” and granted Shi exemption from corvée for four hundred men.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits the closing clause 乃賜式外繇四百人, which records the corvée exemption grant present in the Chinese and literal English.

proposals.before: The emperor considered Shi remarkable, appointed him magistrate of Gou as a trial, and Gou found him effective.
proposals.after: The emperor considered Shi remarkable, appointed him magistrate of Goushi as a trial, and Goushi found him effective.
proposals.reason: 緱氏 is the place-name Goushi; rendering it as bare “Gou” truncates the toponym and obscures the posting.

proposals.before: He was moved and appointed as magistrate of Chenggao, and led transport the best.
proposals.after: He was transferred and appointed magistrate of Chenggao, and his management of the canal transport was rated the best.
proposals.reason: “led transport the best” is ungrammatical and obscures 將漕最, which means his canal-transport leadership was rated foremost.

proposals.before: Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. The governor of Longxi accompanied the journey with troops, but the Son of Heaven’s attendants could not obtain food, and the governor was convicted and killed.
proposals.after: Traveling west, the imperial party crossed Long. Because the journey came suddenly, the governor of Longxi left the Son of Heaven’s attendants without food, and the governor of Longxi committed suicide.
proposals.reason: Chinese 隴西守自殺 means the governor committed suicide; idiomatic 'convicted and killed' invents a judicial execution.

proposals.before: And imperial censor Zhang Tang just exalted noble used affairs, appointed Xuan, Du Zhou etc. as assistant censors, Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wen Shu etc. used cruel urgent harsh deep as nine ministers, and direct finger Xia Lan kind began came out.
proposals.after: And imperial censor Zhang Tang just exalted noble used affairs, Jian Xuan, Du Zhou etc. as assistant censors, Yi Zong, Yin Qi, Wang Wenshu etc. used cruel urgent harsh deep as nine ministers, and direct finger Xia Lan kind began came out.
proposals.reason: Literal drops surname 減 from 減宣 and splits 王溫舒 as 'Wang Wen Shu'.

proposals.before: Yet the counties through which the troops passed merely supplied enough wealth to meet immediate needs; they did not dare mention the laws against unauthorized taxation.
proposals.after: Yet the counties through which the troops passed merely supplied enough wealth to meet immediate needs; they did not dare speak of unauthorized taxation.
proposals.reason: 擅賦法 means unauthorized/arbitrary taxation itself, not laws against it; the idiomatic reversal obscures the sense that counties dared not propose or discuss such levies.

proposals.before: Hong Yang with various officials each self purchased, mutually contended, goods therefore leaped jumped, and world taxes transports or not repaid their hired expenses, then requested established great farmer division assistants several ten people, divided sections mastered commanderies kingdoms, each often county established equal transport salt iron officials, ordered distant places each with their goods expensive time merchants transferred sold ones as taxes, and mutually irrigated input.
proposals.after: Hong Yang with various officials each self purchased, mutually contended, goods therefore leaped jumped, and world taxes transports or not repaid their hired expenses, then requested established great farmer division assistants several ten people, divided sections mastered commanderies kingdoms, each often county established equal transport salt iron officials, ordered distant places each with their goods expensive time merchants transferred sold ones as taxes, and mutually transferred and supplied.
proposals.reason: 相灌輸 means mutual transfer/supply of goods, not irrigation; 'irrigated input' is a false calque that obscures the equal-transport sense.

proposals.before: What it came from was long and distant, and from before the Gaoxin clan it still was, but it could not be recorded.
proposals.after: What it came from was long and distant, dating even from before the Gaoxin clan, yet it could not be recorded.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English is ungrammatical and obscures 尚矣; the clause should mark remote antiquity before Gaoxin, not 'it still was'.

proposals.before: Wei employed Li Ke, fully used the land's productive strength, and became a powerful state.
proposals.after: Wei employed Li Ke, fully used the land's productive strength, and became a strong ruler.
proposals.reason: 為彊君 means became a strong ruler, not a powerful state; the idiomatic rendering shifts the referent of 君.

proposals.before: Therefore, externally repelled barbarian barbarians, internally aroused merit works, within seas scholars strength farmed insufficient grain food, women spun wove insufficient clothes.
proposals.after: Therefore, externally repelled the Yi and Di, internally aroused merit works, within seas men strength farmed insufficient grain food, women spun wove insufficient clothes.
proposals.reason: 夷狄 is calqued twice as 'barbarian barbarians', and 士 is not specifically 'scholars' here.
